---
name: Plot Colors
description: "Use when creating or modifying Python plots and charts; requires plotted data to use blue."
applyTo: "**/*.py"
---
# Plot Color Rule

- Render every plotted data series, mark, line, bar, and filled data region in blue. For multi-series charts, use blue shades only; do not introduce other hues for data.
- Keep non-data elements such as axes, gridlines, labels, and backgrounds neutral when needed for readability.
- Apply this rule across plotting libraries, including Plotly, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.
